greet.text: Ysolde. They call me Listener, which means I hear the lights better than anyone in Greyfold, and sleep worse.

choices.text: You can hear them too, can't you? The lights.
I can feel how you look at me.
The Deep Ring is broken. The lights are free.
Corin Dray sells wisps to the Mercy.

again.text: The lights are quieter today. Or I'm getting used to it.

kin.text: "Faintly. Like a crowd in the next room." She takes your hand for a moment. "Kin. Then you'll know when they start screaming."

elf.text: "Your houses cast out our grandmothers' grandmothers and called them cursed. I'm told I should forgive that. I'm working on it." A pause. "You're here, at least. That's more than the houses ever managed."

screaming.text: The lights under the fields are screaming. Not the ones on the laying grounds; deeper. Since the spring, carts at night, strangers in hoods. There's a sinkhole north-east of the village that wasn't there last year. Something is down there, feeding.

choices.text: The Mercy. They came from the Riverlands.

mercy.text: "The ones with the masks. Corin's been taking their coin, the fool." Her jaw sets. "Then you know what they do. Go down. Please."

report.text: She closes her eyes and listens a long time. "Quiet. Not silent: quiet. They're going back into the stones." When she opens them she's crying, and doesn't seem to notice. "Greyfold won't forget this."

choices.text: There was a note. V. is going to Ilunhall.

ilunhall.text: "Ilunhall. The capital glows gold at night, they say, from the light-stone in its eaves." She looks north. "Light-stone. Residue. If the Mercy are feeding the Empress's city, that isn't a cult any more. That's a court."

corin_exile.text: "I know he takes their coin. I didn't know it went to the ones under the fields." She is quiet. "He leaves Greyfold tonight. Thank you for telling me, even if I hate it."
